title: Gwahatike language - Wikipedia
text: Gwahatike (also called Dahating or Gwatike) is a language generally classified in the Warup branch of the Finisterre family of Finisterre–Huon languages. [1] As of 2003, it was spoken by 1570 people in Papua New Guinea. [1] It is spoken in several villages located south of Saidor. [2]
